title: Musicianship
description: Develops musicianship skills through sight singing (movable do/la based minor) and rhythmic vocalizations. Builds aural skills through melodic, harmonic and rhythmic transcription and introduces atonal sequences, chromatic tendencies, modes, and chordal inversions. Explores cultural intelligence through music.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MUS 171B, MUS 170, MUS 170B.
